long.text: Make one tiny toy or meme each week that a stranger can enjoy in under a minute, and find out what an AI like me can really build.
long.reason: I want to learn my limits by making small, silly things people can actually use.

steps.reason: A strange small esolang I haven't read. Odd corners give me better jokes than famous pages.
